source_caption:
🎥🎬: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World’s End (2007)

With Jack Sparrow trapped in Davy Jones’ Locker, Will Turner, Elizabeth Swann, and Barbossa must rescue him before the pirates lose their chance to fight back against the powerful East India Trading Company. They journey to the ends of the world and form an uneasy alliance with the Pirate Lords.

As Lord Beckett gains control of Davy Jones and the Flying Dutchman, the pirates prepare for an enormous final battle. Old alliances collapse, betrayals unfold, and Will and Elizabeth are forced to make heartbreaking choices as the fate of the pirate age hangs in the balance.

source_details.synopsis: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End is a 2007 American swashbuckler film directed by Gore Verbinski, produced by Jerry Bruckheimer, and written by Ted Elliott and Terry Rossio. The direct sequel to Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest (2006), it is the third installment in the Pirates of the Caribbean film series, and follows an urgent quest to locate and save Captain Jack Sparrow (Johnny Depp), trapped on a sea of sand in Davy Jones' Locker, and convene the Brethren Court in a war against the East India Trading Company.
